from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}


def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))


def outage_refund(payment, amount, at):
    """Refund part of a captured payment after a service outage.

    Adds ``amount`` to ``payment.refunded_amount`` and marks the payment
    ``"refunded"`` once the full captured amount has been refunded.  Returns
    the payment.
    """
    at = ensure_utc(at)
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    captured = round_money(payment.amount)
    refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded + amount > captured:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"{refunded + amount} > {captured}",
        )
    payment.refunded_amount = refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount >= captured:
        payment.status = "refunded"
    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        refunded_amount=payment.refunded_amount,
        at=at,
    )
    return payment

from .errors import BillingError

CENT = Decimal("0.01")
ZERO = Decimal("0.00")


def to_money(value) -> Decimal:
    """Convert an int, str or Decimal into a Decimal amount."""
    if isinstance(value, (bool, float)):
        raise BillingError("float_amount", f"refusing to convert {value!r}")
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return value
    try:
        return Decimal(str(value))
    except InvalidOperation:
        raise BillingError("invalid_amount", repr(value)) from None

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.adjustments import outage_refund
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
T0=datetime(2026,10,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(amt="5000.00"):
    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# at threshold 1000 -> no approval
p=mk(); outage_refund(p,Decimal("1000.00"),T0); print("1000 ok", p.refunded_amount)
# above threshold -> approval_required
p=mk()
try: outage_refund(p,Decimal("1000.01"),T0)
except BillingError as e: print("above:", e.code)
# above with approver
p=mk(); outage_refund(p,Decimal("1000.01"),T0,approved_by="mgr"); print("approved", p.refunded_amount)
# full refund sets status
p=mk("10.00"); outage_refund(p,Decimal("10.00"),T0); print("status", p.status)
# partial keeps captured
p=mk("10.00"); outage_refund(p,Decimal("4.00"),T0); print("partial status", p.status)
# exceeds
p=mk("10.00")
try: outage_refund(p,Decimal("11.00"),T0)
except BillingError as e: print("exceeds:", e.code)
# non-positive
p=mk()
try: outage_refund(p,Decimal("0"),T0)
except BillingError as e: print("zero:", e.code)
# not captured
p=Payment("p","i",Decimal("10"),status="authorized")
try: outage_refund(p,Decimal("1"),T0)
except BillingError as e: print("state:", e.code)
